basics.name: Yufeng Huang
basics.label: AI Systems Engineer | Game AI | LLM-driven Agents
basics.summary: AI systems engineer with 8+ years of industry experience in game AI, interactive agent systems, and AI-assisted production tools across major studios (Tencent, ByteDance, NetEase). Research interests center on human-centered AI agents for interactive virtual environments -- emotionally aware and personalized agents with long-term memory and adaptive behavior.

work.name: Tencent, SGRA Studio
work.summary: Led a five-person AI and tools group for Animula Nook, a pre-launch interactive virtual-world simulation game, focusing on NPC intelligence, agent behavior, and AI-assisted production workflows.
highlights: Designed and built a hybrid NPC AI architecture combining behavior trees, FSMs, utility AI, and LLM-based modules. Each NPC exhibits configurable personality traits, maintains conversation memory, and engages in personalized interaction with players.

Led development of 10+ LLM-powered authoring tools spanning narrative/dialogue generation, behavior tree generation from natural language, construction blueprint generation, and automated cutscene generation.
Explored an automated pipeline where an LLM agent autonomously generates production tools end-to-end.
Contributed to core gameplay systems including character animation, NPC systems, dialogue, quests, combat, and in-game chat.
Previously responsible for building the global distributed server architecture supporting 1M+ DAU for shared-world multiplayer.

work.name: ByteDance, Nuverse
work.summary: Developed game AI systems and production tools across multiple studio projects.
highlights: Built the battle AI system for Dragonheir: Silent Gods using behavior trees and state machines; explored RL for hero lineup composition.
Designed complex multi-phase boss AI using layered behavior trees and state machines.
Built an event-driven blueprint-based NPC AI system supporting 1,000+ concurrent NPCs per scene.
Developed a utility-based ambient NPC behavior system for an internal open-world ARPG project.
Explored generative AI in game production, including diffusion-based concept art, text-to-motion generation, and video-based motion capture.
Built internal authoring tools including blueprint editors, behavior tree editors, narrative editors, quest editors, and dialogue editors.

work.name: NetEase Games
work.summary: Worked on an internal open-world MMORPG project.
highlights: Developed gameplay systems (character control, camera, level system, etc.).
Built companion AI combining behavior trees and utility AI for NPC allies.

work.name: NetEase Games
work.summary: Worked on Onmyoji Arena, a launched MOBA title.
highlights: Shipped multiple gameplay systems including hero skills, in-game activity systems, and battle pass systems.
Gained working knowledge of utility-based MOBA combat AI and participated in RL-based PvP agent research.

projects.name: Mimosa -- Multimodal Emotion-Aware Virtual Companion System
projects.summary: An end-to-end multimodal virtual companion that senses and responds to human emotion through voice and text, building a personalized and adaptive long-term relationship.
highlights: Built a real-time voice and text interaction system with Live2D avatar, integrating VAD, ASR, LLM-based dialogue, emotion extraction, expression mapping, and TTS.
Implemented a Big Five-based configurable personality system with bounded self-evolution via LLM-based reflection.
Designed automatic memory extraction for cross-session continuity and personalization.

projects.name: llm-persona-gap -- Personality Alignment Evaluation Framework
projects.summary: A quantitative research framework for measuring the gap between expressed and behavioral personality in LLM-driven agents.
highlights: Modeled personality as a continuous 4D vector injected into agent prompts for controlled experiments.
Implemented dual-channel measurement extracting behavioral personality from action trajectories and expressed personality from reasoning text.
Tested agents in Leduc Hold'em across 100+ episodes; observed significant misalignment in specific dimensions.
